June 7, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Savant Capital Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 9.06% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Savant Capital Llc bought 4,157 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 50,059 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $8.40M, up from 45,902 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Savant Capital Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $949.65 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.40% or $0.77 during the last trading session, reaching $193.21. About 10.01M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 7, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500. Thomas Steyer decreased its stake in Time Warner Inc (TWX) by 76.08% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Farallon Capital Management Llc sold 3.25 million shares as the company’s stock declined 1.16% with the market. The hedge fund run by Thomas Steyer held 1.02M shares of the television services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $96.47 million, down from 4.27 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Farallon Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Time Warner Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $74.53B market cap company. The stock increased 0.37% or $0.35 during the last trading session, reaching $95.27. About 2.80 million shares traded. Time Warner Inc. (NYSE:TWX) has declined 5.23% since June 7, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.80% the S&P500.
